title: A Sound by the Shed
lines: It was a wet day at the start of the year.
Fern went out to the yard after the rain.
She could hear a small sound near the shed.
It was not clear at all. It was very small.
Fern felt a bit of fear and stood still.
Then the sound came back, like a cry.
"Dad, I hear a sound," she called.
Dad came out and said, "I am near, dear."
They went to the shed and looked all round.
Fern got down and held her ear near the grass.
The sound got more clear on that side.
It came from a big box by the shed wall.
A flat lid was shut on the top of it.
Fern tried to lift the lid, but it was stuck.
So she tipped the box on its side.
Out slid a small wet pup, on to her lap!
It had gone in to get out of the rain.
Then the lid had slipped down and shut it in.
The pup gave a big shake and got Fern wet.
It licked her hand and her ear.
"You have good ears, dear," said Dad.
Fern has had that pup for a year now.

questions.ask: What was making the sound, and where was it?
questions.listenFor: A small wet pup, shut in a big box by the shed.

questions.ask: What did Fern try first to get the pup out, and did it work?
questions.listenFor: She tried to lift the lid. It was stuck, so she tipped the box on its side.

questions.ask: What would you have done if you heard that sound? Why?
questions.listenFor: Any answer works. Listen for a because, not for bravery.
